channel.title: The Travel Show
channel.desc: Rob Bell is on an adventure through Norway's western fjords to explore the country's efforts to protect this landscape for future generations. In Geiranger, a UNESCO World Heritage site, he meets the dedicated scientists monitoring the monumental crevasse in Arknes mountain which threatens to collapse within the next 200 years. He climbs Europe's highest sea cliff, one of ten new National Parks the country's creating, and takes a home-grown electric car prototype for a spin.
